item.title: Green or amber traffic light is not working problem, 6th August
item.description:
Email received 27/07/2026 - copy attached: Hi, Given there is no option on the fix my street App….. : Following an RTC last week on the A40, at Sixways, London Road, Charlton Kings, which completely removed one of several traffic lights at this location, their phasing now appears to be unbalanced and is resulting in lengthy queues in both directions of the A40 road. Also, due to the lack of a second red light filter for those wishing to turn right into Greenway Lane, drivers are constantly jumping it, so causing danger to other drivers. Would it be possible for engineers to visit the location and to address the aforementioned issues, please.
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Unpermitted roadworks problem, 6th August
item.description:
Email received 27/07/2026 - copy attached. Customer writes: Complaint & Immediate Resolution Required – Promenade Taxi Rank Displacement Dear Gloucestershire County Council, I am writing on behalf of the local taxi trade to express our extreme dissatisfaction with the Council's complete failure to provide alternative arrangements for the Promenade Taxi Rank during the filming scheduled from 2 August. Disrupting a primary taxi rank during a end-of-month pay weekend—one of the most critical revenue periods for our drivers—without a pre-arranged contingency plan is entirely unacceptable and demonstrates a blatant disregard for our livelihood. Leaving the trade without a functional workspace during peak demand is an unsustainable lapse in management. We require an immediate, viable temporary rank to be designated before filming commences. Coning off the parking area outside Imperial Gardens—which already holds designated taxi usage after 6:00 PM—would serve as an immediate and practical solution. Please confirm the Council's action plan and designated alternative locations as a matter of urgency.
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Blocked drainage pipe serving road gullies, 6th August
item.description:
There appears to be a block drain pipe which is getting worse at the junction of Crippets lane and church road. The water is showing on the corner of Crippets lane but most of it is entering a bt duct below ground and then exiting outside Karroo cottage where the duct ends. Previous jetting opposite and further down stream has helped to take this away so further jetting around the crossroads hopefully will be the final visit.
